column1: # Reviewed native Windows FFI boundary; separate from historical panic allowances.
# COM initialization, interfaces and BSTRs stay on one worker apartment.
# Enumeration outputs and pipe handles remain live and exclusively borrowed.
# Each unsafe operation is justified by its adjacent SAFETY comment.
# The complete token fingerprint detects body changes; only exact unsafe rows
# below are allowed. Panic/unwrap operations are never exempted.
# Reviewed cleanup log tag/fields only; native operations and allowances are unchanged.
